title: FSAE Team
oneLine: Suspension and chassis parts I designed and machined for a Formula SAE car.

hero.alt: Generated stand-in image for FSAE Team. Not a photograph of the real build.

intake.question: What is it, in one sentence?
intake.hint: Which subsystem you owned and what it does on the car. Suspension, chassis, drivetrain, aero, electronics. The site is about your part.

intake.question: Role, timeline, status
intake.hint: Team size, your title, which season, hours a week. Did the car pass tech and finish the event, and where did you place.

intake.question: What made it hard?
intake.hint: A rules constraint, the cost cap, what your shop could actually manufacture, the schedule, or a teammate leaving. The rulebook is usually the interesting constraint, so name the rule.
intake.answer: Formula SAE parts have to survive the load cases the rules define while staying light, and they have to be manufacturable by students on the machines the team actually owns rather than the ones in the textbook.

intake.question: What did you decide, and what did you reject?
intake.hint: A material, geometry, or process choice and the one you rejected. Steel tube versus bonded aluminum, that damper over another, welded versus machined.
intake.answer: Where a lighter design depended on a process the team could not do reliably, I took the heavier one that we could make twice. A part that exists and is a little heavy beats a part that is optimal and never gets cut.

intake.question: What number can you put on it?
intake.hint: Mass in kg, stiffness, deflection under load, lap time, cost per unit, FEA safety factor, placing at comp.

intake.question: What broke, and what did you do?
intake.hint: What failed in testing or at the event and what you did about it. FSAE always breaks something. This will be the best paragraph on the page.

intake.question: What media do you have?
intake.hint: CAD screenshots, FEA plots, the part on the car, the car running. A photo of your part installed beats any render.

intake.question: What would you do differently?
intake.hint: Two sentences. Not self criticism, a design judgement you would make differently now.
